chunks: "A boy is required to fast when he reaches puberty, and a woman is required to fast when she menstruates."

key_terms.احْتَلَمَ: reached puberty through experiencing a nocturnal emission
key_terms.الصَّبِيِّ: the boy; a male child prior to legal maturity
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman; here referring to the female becoming legally responsible
key_terms.حَاضَتِ: menstruated; the onset of menses as a sign of maturity

ai.seo_question: When does fasting become obligatory for boys and girls in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This report states the point at which the duty of sawm (fasting) becomes binding: for a boy, upon puberty marked by nocturnal emission, and for a woman, upon the onset of menstruation. It is significant as a concise fiqh indicator of legal responsibility for fasting.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "A boy is required to fast when he reaches puberty, and a woman is required to fast when she menstruates."
